CFML Language Reference: Functions

LSIsCurrency

Returns True if the string can be read as a currency amount: a number, optionally with the currency symbol, thousands separators and parentheses for negative amounts.

Category

International functions

Syntax

LSIsCurrency(string)

Parameters

string
The string to test, for example "$1,234.50" or "($19.99)".

Returns

True (YES) or False (NO).

Usage

Use it to validate form input before you hand it to LSParseCurrency, which throws an error for strings it cannot read. KoldFusion recognizes the English (US) conventions only (see SetLocale).

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Tests = "$1,234.50|($19.99)|1999|12 dollars|$|abc">
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>String</TH><TH>LSIsCurrency</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="S" LIST="#Tests#" DELIMITERS="|">
<CFOUTPUT>
<TR><TD>#S#</TD><TD>#LSIsCurrency(S)#</TD></TR>
</CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>

See also

LSParseCurrency, LSCurrencyFormat, LSIsNumeric, IsNumeric
